details: Desktop sim emits passive contact mix and event cues via subsim/game.py and subsim/audio.py.
Game.build_observation() exposes acoustic.schema_version, acoustic.foundation, and acoustic.contacts.
Historically silent due to missing Godot playback implementation.
Godot now has AcousticMixer playback nodes and signal wiring.
Engine now emits sfx_return in addition to mix_contact, sfx_ping, and sfx_fire.

implemented: Passive contact loop rendering with variant selection (clean/lp1/lp2/lp3).
Desktop contact-loop lifecycle cleanup for stale/removed contacts.
Godot contact variant selection now uses contract inputs (confidence + own-noise + inferred occlusion) instead of gain-only buckets.
Ping/fire/return cue families in Godot frontend.
Event/cue taxonomy documented in canonical contract.
still_thin: No full clutter/biologics redesign in this pass.

details: RL/playtester consumes abstract acoustic state, not waveform buffers.
Sonar console ownship context now uses shared foundation semantics.

automated.command: wiring checks via rg for AcousticMixer and emitted signals

manual_required: Install APK to handset and verify audible ambient bed, passive loops, ping/fire/return cues.
Confirm Android device routing/volume path is non-muted for speaker/headphones.
limitations: CI/headless checks cannot prove handset audibility.
Godot frontend uses simplified engine path relative to desktop sim.

known_gaps: Desktop has richer event taxonomy than current Godot stub parity.
Godot frontend infers coarse occlusion because engine stub does not emit explicit occlusion layers.
No waveform-level RL policy input in this pass.
Asset library remains mostly procedural placeholders.
recommended_follow_on: Add ambient biome diversity and propulsion regime layering.
Expand contact signature subclasses and timbre differentiation.
Add repeatable on-device APK acoustic regression checklist.
